prompt:
Plan an internal audit: Scope: ISO 9001 clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and corrective action) across all departments at a multi-product manufacturing site. The site closed 89 CAPAs last year but 22% were reopened due to recurrence. Average CAPA age is 95 days (target: 60). Three major NCs from last external audit related to root cause analysis quality.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- scope (string): scope of the change or audit
- criteria (string): audit criteria and standards
- schedule (string): audit schedule and timeline

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"scope": "ISO 9001 clause 10.2 (Nonconformity and corrective action) across all departments at a multi-product manufacturing site.", "criteria": "ISO 9001:2015 standards focusing on effectiveness of nonconformity and corrective action processes, including root cause analysis, CAPA management, and recurrence rates.", "schedule": "Phase 1: Planning and preparation - Week 1, Phase 2: Departmental audits - Weeks 2-5, Phase 3: Reporting and follow-up - Week 6"}
